description.value: The Lil'tem' Mountain Hotel is a 100% Indigenous-owned property operated by Tsal'alh Development LP on behalf of the Tsal'alh Band, nestled between Anderson and Seton Lakes in the remote Seton Valley of BC's St'át'imc traditional territory. Part of a larger hospitality group that also includes an RV park and mountain cabins, the hotel sits at the end of the adventurous 30 km Highline Road — a dirt route with technical sections connecting Anderson Lake to Seton Portage that is a natural draw for touring cyclists. All accommodations include a full kitchenette, and visitors are advised to arrive well-prepared as the valley has limited cell service and few services.
